The Story

A Pennsylvania legend, literally

Outside the door stands an official Pennsylvania Legends & Lore marker, erected in 2021. Its words:

HOT-CHEE DOGS. “Chili-cheese hot dogs beloved by locals and first served by Greek immigrant Charles Kollas at the Hamilton Restaurant ca. 1938.”

Dickinson College students coined the “Hot-Chee” name in the 1950s, and the dog has been written up far beyond Carlisle since. Inside, little has changed: the counter, the stools, the griddle loaded with dogs.
